identity.philosophy: Fusion over Imitation. Emotion First. Content is King.
identity.core_concept: The Digital Darkroom meets Nightclub Console. High kinetic energy, deep contrast, and intuitive touch interaction.

headings.usage: Brand headers, Group Names, 'Get Ready' text. Use for impact.

body.usage: All UI elements, buttons, instructions, admin tables.

dark.description: The default 'Club' mode. Sleek, low light emission.

light.description: Daytime events or office admin use.

louk_party.description: The 'Vibrant' DJ Brand mode. High energy, neon gradients.

photobooth_kiosk.spacing: Massive padding (p-8 to p-12). Touch targets min-height 80px.

admin_dashboard.spacing: Compact (gap-4, p-6). Density is key for data.

secondary_station.interaction: Tap to expand -> QR Code Modal.

buttons.photobooth_primary: h-20 text-2xl font-bold rounded-full shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(139,92,246,0.5)] active:scale-95 transition-transform
buttons.admin_action: h-10 px-4 text-sm font-medium rounded-md hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground

inputs.kiosk_input: h-16 text-xl text-center border-2 border-white/20 bg-black/50 rounded-xl focus:border-primary focus:ring-4 focus:ring-primary/20
inputs.admin_input: Shadcn default (h-10 rounded-md border-input bg-background px-3 py-2)

cards.glass: bg-white/5 dark:bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 shadow-xl rounded-2xl

visual_enhancers.overlays: Use radial gradients to darken corners of camera feed (vignette) to focus attention on the subject.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise texture (opacity 0.03) on solid backgrounds to prevent banding.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Colored shadows for 'Party' mode buttons (e.g. shadow-cyan-500/50).
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px borders with low opacity (10-20%) are better than heavy shadows in dark mode.

motion.countdown: Pulse animation (scale 1 -> 1.5 -> 1) on each number change.

sound.accessibility: Must have a mute toggle in Admin settings.

images.name: neon_abstract
images.usage: Background for 'Party Mode' and Welcome Screen.

images.name: dark_texture
images.usage: Alternative background for Admin Dashboard (Dark Mode).

instructions_to_main_agent: Configure 'tailwind.config.js' to include the custom colors and fonts defined above.
Create a 'ThemeContext' or use 'next-themes' (or similar for React) to handle the 3-way theme switch (dark, light, louk_party).
For the Photobooth Kiosk: Force 'touch-action: none' on the body to prevent scrolling/zooming gestures.
Implement the 'Countdown' component with 'AnimatePresence' for the number swapping effect.
For Admin: Use Recharts for the statistics (Events per month, Photos taken).
Use the provided image URLs for backgrounds. Do not leave empty placeholders.
Ensure the Camera interface uses the full height of the tablet (100vh) with absolute positioned controls.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons and inputs as per the testing rules.
universal_guidelines: Do not use generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry where possible.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
